receives a **work order from M/s Meershiv Projects Private Limited aggregating Rs 30.05 crore inclusive of GST** for the **turnkey design, engineering, civil works, supply, installation, testing and commissioning of the complete electro-mechanical and instrumentation system for a 10 MLD waste-water treatment plant**, over **12 months**, with a **12-month defect liability period** on the executed pipe network. At **~44.9% of a Rs 67.00 cr market cap** it is proportionally the largest award of the day; it stays a theme line because Rs 30 crore is a small absolute sum and the counterparty is a private contractor rather than the end client.
